title: in/at/on (position) 2
subtitle: in a row / on the left / at the top
summary: Learn the fixed phrases with in, at and on for rows, floors, lists, tops and bottoms, fronts and backs, and corners.

lesson.heading: in a row, in a picture, in the sky
lesson.text: We say that somebody or something is **in a line / in a row / in a queue**, **in a picture / in a photograph**, **in a newspaper / in a magazine / in a book**, **in an office / in a department**, **in the sky / in the world**, and **in the country** (= not in a town).

examples.text: When I go to the cinema, I like to sit **in the front row**.
Who is the woman **in that picture**?
Do you live in a city or **in the country**?
It's a lovely day. There isn't a cloud **in the sky**.

lesson.heading: on the left, on the second floor, on a list
lesson.text: We say **on the left / on the right** (or on the left-hand side), **on the ground floor / on the first floor**, and **on a map / on a menu / on a list / on a page / on a website**.

examples.text: Do you drive **on the left** or **on the right** in your country?
Our apartment is **on the second floor** of the building.
Here's the shopping list. Don't buy anything that's not **on the list**.
You'll find the information you need **on our website**.

lesson.heading: on a river, on the coast, on the way
lesson.text: We say that a place is **on a river / on a road / on the coast**. We also say **on the way** from one place to another.

examples.text: The town where you live - is it **on the coast** or is it inland?
We stopped at a shop **on the way home**.

lesson.heading: at the top, at the bottom, at the end
lesson.text: We say **at the top (of ...)**, **at the bottom (of ...)** and **at the end (of ...)**.

examples.text: Write your name **at the top of the page**.
Jane lives **at the other end of the street**.
They live in a small house **at the bottom of the hill**.

lesson.heading: front and back

left.label: in the front / in the back of a car
examples: I was **in the back** (of the car) when we had the accident.
When I'm a passenger, I prefer to sit **in the front**.

right.label: at the front / at the back of a building or group
examples: The garden is **at the back of the house**.
Let's sit **at the front** (of the cinema).
We were **at the back**, so we couldn't see very well.

lesson.note: But for an envelope or a piece of paper we say **on the front** / **on the back**: I wrote the date **on the back of the photo**.

lesson.heading: in the corner or at the corner?

left.label: in the corner of a room
examples: The TV is **in the corner of the room**.

right.label: at (or on) the corner of a street
examples: There is a small shop **at the corner** of the street.
or ... **on the corner** of the street.

lesson.text: Remember the pairs: in the back of a car, but at the back of a building and on the back of an envelope.

exercises.prompt: It's a lovely day. There isn't a cloud ___.
exercises.explanation: We say in the sky, like in the world.
We say on the left / on the right (or on the left-hand side).

exercises.prompt: Joe works ___ of a large store.
exercises.explanation: We work in a department and in an office.

exercises.prompt: I met a friend of mine ___ this morning.
exercises.explanation: We say on the way from one place to another.

exercises.prompt: Match the two halves of the sentences.

pairs.right: at the top of the page
at the back of the house
on the back of the photo
in the corner of the room
at the corner of the street
at the other end of the street

exercises.prompt: We couldn't see the film very well because we were sitting ___ of the cinema.
exercises.explanation: For a building, a theatre or a group of people we say at the front / at the back.

exercises.prompt: San Francisco is ___ of the United States.
exercises.explanation: A place is on the coast, on a river or on a road.

exercises.statement: The TV is at the corner of the room.
exercises.explanation: The TV is in the corner of the room. We use at (or on) the corner only for a street.

exercises.prompt: We went to the theatre last night. We had seats ___.
exercises.explanation: We sit in a row, in a line and in a queue.

exercises.prompt: I don't have your address. Could you write it ___?
options: on the back of this card
in the back of this card
at the back of this card
exercises.explanation: For a piece of paper, a card or an envelope we say on the front / on the back.

exercises.prompt: Which preposition goes with each phrase?
My office is on the top floor. It's ___ your left as you come out of the lift.
exercises.explanation: We say on the left / on the right.
